title: Implement Health Data
description:
Following the plan in `@docs/HEALTH_DATA.md`

## Status (end-to-end)
Compass health-data is implemented end-to-end with Open Wearables (OW) compatibility as the primary contract.

### Implemented
- Storage
  - Raw table stores OW timeseries + events.
  - Daily table stores OW daily summaries bundle (`activity` / `sleep` / `recovery`).
  - Canonical merge is summary-aware with precedence `whoop > fitbit > oura`.
- Providers
  - Whoop, Oura, Fitbit adapters normalize provider payloads into OW snake_case records.
- API
  - `HealthDataService` + REST endpoints are wired.
  - Admin seed endpoint exists (`POST /admin/health-data/seed`).
- Tests
  - Unit + e2e tests updated to match the OW contract.

## OW compatibility hardening (completed)
### 1) DTO typings aligned to OW contract
- Tightened DTO TypeScript typings while keeping Swagger decorators permissive (`type: Object`) where needed:
  - `src/models/health-data/HealthDataDailyResponse.dto.ts`
    - `metricsCanonical: OpenWearablesDailySummaries`
    - `metricsByProvider?: Partial<Record<HealthDataProvider, OpenWearablesDailySummaries>>`
  - `src/models/health-data/HealthDataRawResponse.dto.ts`
    - `data: OpenWearablesRecord`
  - `src/models/admin/AdminHealthDataSeedRequest.dto.ts`
    - Confirmed `provider: HealthDataProvider` + validation.

### 2) OW schema parity audit + datetime compatibility
- Audited our schemas/types against upstream OW schemas (`common_types.py`, `timeseries.py`, `events.py`, `summaries.py`).
- Implemented more permissive OW-compatible datetime parsing:
  - Accept RFC3339 with offset, RFC3339 with `Z`, and offsetless ISO datetimes (Fitbit-style, e.g. `2020-05-01T06:20:00.000`).
- Documented that OW defines additional event types beyond what we currently ingest; our internal union is intentionally limited to `Workout | SleepSession` and should be extended if we add more event ingestion.

### 3) Fitbit docs-driven e2e payload-shape verification
- Strengthened live Fitbit e2e payload envelope validation prior to normalization:
  - Daily activity summary: asserts `summary` + `goals` exist; `summary.distances` is an array of `{ activity, distance }`.
  - Sleep list: validates standard envelope and meta-processing responses; follows `pagination.next` once when present.
  - Activity log list: validates `activities` array + optional `pagination.next`.
- Corrected OW workout expectation in e2e: `Workout.type` is the activity type/name (non-empty string), not the literal string `'workout'`.

## Checks
- `compileCheck` is green.
